# Waveup

> Waveup is a venture capital consulting firm specializing in fundraising strategy, investment materials creation, and M&A advisory for startups across all funding stages.

Waveup has helped 300+ startups raise over $3B in funding across 80+ industries. The firm provides end-to-end services including pitch deck consulting, financial modeling, investor targeting, and post-investment support.

## Key Topics

- Venture Capital (VC)
- Fundraising Strategy
- Pitch Deck Consulting
- Financial Modeling
- Series A/B/C Funding
- Investor Relations
- M&A Advisory
- Pre-Seed & Seed Funding
- Investor Targeting & Outreach
- Investment Materials
- Due Diligence
- Business Planning
- Startup Growth Strategy
